t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Maken teūnku. Teuti Goti, en teni uwandaü. Temi uwanda nai enau rotu te ena inde. Make wani teūnku. Makē eranda iyen ruke eni eraran mana teūnku. Makē teni eyen rukana eyan rukanami. Byawa ena Goti wami eya ō wam nami. Anda kim wana tiya-ya nom wanam mi. Wanana wana mi.
